name: Plan comparison matrix
definition: Table of features grouped by theme down the side and plans across the top, with a filter to show only differences.
bestUse: Buyers checking a specific capability before choosing a plan.

demo.how: Features are grouped under short headings and every plan is a column, so one capability can be checked across plans in a single row. Turn on Show differences only to hide rows where every plan is the same; the middle plan column stays highlighted. Features are illustrative.
